description: This stacked bar chart illustrates the number of datasets categorized by target type over a series of years. The horizontal axis represents the "Year," displaying chronological categories from 2012 to 2022. The vertical axis is labeled "Number of datasets" and uses a linear scale ranging from 0 to 160, with tick marks and corresponding horizontal grid lines at intervals of 20. The chart features stacked bars for each year, where the components are defined by a legend titled "Targets." The bottom segment of each stack represents "Untargeted" datasets, colored in dark blue, while the top segment represents "Targeted" datasets, colored in brown. The total height of the bars varies across the chronological sorting, with the shortest bars occurring in 2012 and 2013, representing approximately 2 datasets each (with 2012 consisting almost entirely of targeted datasets and 2013 consisting entirely of untargeted datasets). The tallest bar is in 2021, reaching a total value of 160, composed of approximately 67 untargeted and 93 targeted datasets. Other approximate total values include 13 in 2016, 28 in 2017, 48 in 2018, 65 in 2019, and 130 in 2020. Notably, the final bar representing the year 2022, which shows a total of approximately 37 datasets, is visually distinguished from the others by being rendered in faded, lower-opacity shades of the blue and brown colors.
